problem.title: Reverse Substrings Between Each Pair of Parentheses

approaches.title: Stack-based substring reversal
approaches.summary: Use a stack to track opening-parenthesis boundaries and reverse the accumulated substring whenever a closing parenthesis is encountered. Revision 2 builds the output directly instead of mutating the input buffer, while preserving the same core strategy.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Stores opening-parenthesis indices in a stack and reverses each matched substring in place, then removes parentheses from the byte buffer.

revisions.commitBody:
previous method did the reversals in-place. No point doing that since
result requires a new vector anyway
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Builds the result directly while using stack offsets to reverse the current suffix on each closing parenthesis, avoiding in-place mutation of the input.
